name: Capri Townhomes
tagline: Seven move-in-ready townhomes one block from the beach
summary: Capri Townhomes is a completed, move-in-ready collection of just seven five-bedroom, four-bath townhomes of approximately 3,000 square feet in Treasure Island, one block from the beach. Very rare zoning allows owners to homestead or to rent nightly and weekly, and each home has a private rooftop deck built to support a hot tub.

faqs.q: Can Capri Townhomes be rented nightly?
faqs.a: Yes. Capri Townhomes allows nightly and weekly rentals (1–7 day stays). Owners may also homestead the property as a primary residence.

faqs.q: Is a management company required at Capri Townhomes?
faqs.a: No. There is no required management company. Owners may self-manage or choose any manager.

faqs.q: How close is Capri Townhomes to the beach?
faqs.a: Capri Townhomes is one block from Treasure Island beach and close to John's Pass Village and Downtown St. Pete.

faqs.q: What is the projected rental revenue at Capri Townhomes?
faqs.a: Projected gross rental revenue is $215,000 per year, per Stay Dreams Rentals / Resort Rentals and verified by other residences in the complex. Projections are not guaranteed.
